_comment: Throwaway fixture keypair. NOT the production signing key. Pins the licence key format across the generator and the platform. iid = sha3Hex(9f3a1c02-4b6d-4c3e-9a10-2f7c5d3e8b71). privateKeyPem is intentionally omitted from this copy -- nothing in this repo reads it; it lives only in the generator repo (inferrix-license-keygen), which needs it to re-sign and byte-compare against expectedKey.
